name: Deathclaw Egg
blurb: Every known world spawn for Deathclaw Eggs, grouped by region. Directions and photos are added by hand.

world_spawns.note: Raw Deathclaw Eggs spawn loose at 36 LPI points, each rolling a per-server-hop chance (computed). Deathclaw nests are listed below with their own rate.

containers.note: 19 deathclaw nest containers (12 DeathclawNest01 + 7 SFM04), both bases sharing the one loot list, so all 19 carry the same rate. Each nest's chance to contain 1 raw egg + 1 cracked egg is computed by rng76 from Container_Loot_DeathclawNest01. It is the same roll — a nest holds both eggs or neither.

locations.directions: These locations are accessible whether the event is running or not.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #1
spawns.directions: After entering the Tunnel of Love, face north and follow the train tracks until you reach the area with the pink heart lights. Turn left, pass the orange forklift, and stop at the second set of tracks. Turn left again and walk forward into a small cave. There are four nests in the pile on your right.

spawns.directions: There are four nests in the pile on your right.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #5
spawns.directions: From there, turn around and follow the tracks to the end. Turn right and walk along the road wall until you reach some scaffolding with a wooden ramp leading up. Follow the ramp to the top of the scaffolding. At the top, turn left and follow the path until you see a break in the fence and a small cave on your left. Inside the cave, there is one Deathclaw nest to check.

locations.directions:
From the fast travel point, run straight through the doorway to the bottom of the stairs. Turn left, pass the Nuka-Cola and Medical Supplies machines, and run up the stairs in front of you. Follow the corridor around, pass the Arktos Pharma sign, and enter the doorway on your left. Continue straight ahead and enter the second doorway on your left.

From there, head slightly right and walk through the gap in the wall directly opposite you. Jump down to ground level, turn around, and enter the doorway marked Protein Sequencing. Turn right and walk down the stairs. The Deathclaw Egg will be on the metal shelves in front of you.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg
spawns.directions: From the fast travel point, run straight through the doorway to the bottom of the stairs. Turn left, pass the Nuka-Cola and Medical Supplies machines, and run up the stairs in front of you. Follow the corridor around, pass the Arktos Pharma sign, and enter the doorway on your left. Continue straight and enter the second doorway on your left. Head slightly right and walk through the gap in the wall directly opposite. Jump down to ground level, turn around, and enter the doorway marked Protein Sequencing. Turn right and walk down the stairs — the Deathclaw Egg is on the metal shelves in front of you.

locations.directions: Both eggs sit at the Deathclaw nest. The eggs can be hidden under the dirt when the Deathclaw pops out, so lead the Deathclaw away from the nest before killing it — that way you can loot the nest without the body getting in the way or covering the loot. Also check the white suitcase on the side of the nest; it can sometimes spawn additional Deathclaw eggs.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg #1
spawns.directions: The western of the two eggs, on the Deathclaw nest itself. Lead the Deathclaw away from the nest before killing it, so the body doesn't cover the loot, and check under the dirt if the egg isn't immediately visible.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg #2
spawns.directions: The eastern of the two eggs, a few steps along on the far side of the nest. Also worth checking the white suitcase on the side of the nest — it can sometimes spawn additional Deathclaw eggs.

locations.directions: This egg is mapped for completeness, but it cannot be collected.

locations.directions: From the fast travel point, run straight across the road and enter the cave. Everything below is described from the first nest, which is on the left-hand side of the cave just past the small pond of water near the entrance.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg #1
spawns.directions: Sits on top of the first Deathclaw nest, on the left-hand side of the cave just past the small pond of water near the entrance.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg #2
spawns.directions: From the nest, turn and face east. Walk forward to the back of the cave until you reach a rock face, then turn left. This Deathclaw Egg spawns behind the Firecracker Berry bush.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg #3
spawns.directions: From the nest, turn and face west. Follow the edge of the pond as it curves around the cave, continuing along the water until you see a small campfire and a sleeping bag. This egg is behind the sleeping bag, against the rock face and to the left of a Firecracker Berry bush — the final Deathclaw Egg spawn for this area.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest
spawns.directions: The first Deathclaw nest, on the left-hand side of the cave just past the small pond of water near the entrance. Deathclaw Egg #1 can spawn on top of this nest.

locations.directions:
Note: You will need the Marsupial mutation to access this location.

From the fast travel point, follow the road until you reach the main pillar with the elevator at the bottom. Enter the elevator and select floor 2. Make sure you press 2, as selecting the wrong floor will take you to a different area.

Exit the elevator and follow the path to your left. Continue along the path until you reach a building. Jump onto the roof and follow it around, keeping to the left and away from the edge. The Deathclaw Egg is located in the far corner as part of a picnic scene.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg
spawns.directions: Note: you need the Marsupial mutation to reach this spot. From the fast travel point, follow the road until you reach the main pillar with the elevator at the bottom. Enter the elevator and select floor 2 — make sure you press 2, as the wrong floor takes you to a different area. Exit and follow the path to your left, continuing until you reach a building. Jump onto the roof and follow it around, keeping to the left and away from the edge — the Deathclaw Egg is in the far corner as part of a picnic scene.

locations.marker: Dark Hollow Manor (Vault 63 > Atrium Upper Level)
locations.directions:
You would have needed to start the Vault 63 questline The Calm Before to access this spawn.

Fast Travel to Dark Hollow Manor > Atrium Upper Level

You will spawn inside the elevator. Open the door and walk forward until you reach the door at the end. Open the door and take your first left. Walk straight until you hit the desk with the terminal. Turn right and follow the stairs down to the bottom. Continue heading East and follow the path around until you see the double door marked Security on your left.
Turn left and follow the path around until you hit a dead end. Turn right and enter the room marked Security. Face North and you will see the Deathclaw Egg balancing on top of a cup, on the metal shelf, next to the radio, against the back wall.

locations.directions:
Stand at the door of Ella Ames's Bunker and look toward the blue ute in the water ahead of you. Behind the ute are four trees arranged in a loose semicircle. Starting from the left, head toward the third tree. Stand behind it and look for a tree stump and a light-coloured tree with red leaves in front of you.

Run to the red-leafed tree, then turn south and walk to the river's edge. Turn left and follow the riverbank. Just past the curve in the bank, you'll find the Deathclaw nest on your right.

locations.directions:
From the fast travel point, follow the road south until you reach the end of the limo. Turn left, pass the tank, and enter the workshop yard. Continue straight along the road until you reach the green shipping containers near the water's edge. Jump over the railing and keep the concrete wall on your right as you follow it along.

At the end of the wall, line yourself up between south and the Braxson's Quality Medical Supplies map icon, then walk forward along the riverbank. As the bank begins to curve, look to your right for the Deathclaw nest.

locations.directions: From the spawn-in location, line yourself up with the Ash Cave map marker and run straight up the hill. Continue running forward and stop at the top of the stairs. Veer right and continue to follow the path straight (north-ish) until you reach the pond. Turn right and enter the small cave. The Deathclaw Egg will be against the north wall, behind the Brain Fungus and near the bobblehead spawn.

locations.directions:
From the spawn-in location, face north and run forward, stopping just past the Welcome to Dino Peak entrance sign. Turn left and walk over to the Hole 1 sign.

Line yourself up with the Hole 1 putting green and follow it to the end.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #1
spawns.directions: Face north, go up the stairs, and stop at Hole 2. Turn northwest, and you’ll see Hole 3. Walk over to Hole 3 and follow the putting green to the end. This is the first Deathclaw nest. A Deathclaw Egg can also spawn on top of this nest.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg #1
spawns.directions: A Deathclaw Egg can also spawn on top of this nest.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #2
spawns.directions: Stand on top of the nest above and face north. Take a few steps forward, and you’ll be standing on the next Deathclaw nest. This nest can be partially covered by dirt depending on how the Deathclaw exits, so you may need to move your cursor around slightly to find the inventory window.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #3
spawns.directions: Stand on the nest above and face east. Go up the stairs and follow the blood trail to a small sign with an arrow. Continue up the stairs directly in front of you. At the top of the stairs is another Deathclaw nest. This one is also covered in dirt, so you’ll need to move your cursor around a bit to interact with it.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #4
spawns.directions: Stand on top of the nest above and face east. Walk forward and stop at the Deathclaw nest at the end of Hole 5. A Deathclaw Egg can also spawn on top of this nest.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Egg #2
spawns.directions: A Deathclaw Egg can also spawn on top of this nest.

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #5
spawns.directions: Stand on top of the nest above and face south. Walk forward and stop at the bottom of the stairs. Turn left and take a few steps forward to reach the next Deathclaw nest. This one is also covered in dirt, so wave your cursor around like the world is about to end… wait…

spawns.label: Deathclaw Nest #6
spawns.directions: Stand on top of the nest above and face southwest. Walk over to the start of Hole 6 directly in front of you. Follow the putting green to the end to find the final Deathclaw nest in this area.

Fast Travel to Highway Town > Main Entrance

From the spawn in location, walk straight to the motorbike statue and turn East. Follow the path, going left around the wall until you reach the exit sign. Turn around and walk down the ramp into the Underbelly.

At the bottom of the ramp, walk forward and take the path on the right, along the front of the shipping containers. Stop at the second blue shipping container doorway on your right and the Deathclaw Egg will spawn on the metal shelf just inside the container.

locations.directions:
From the spawn-in location, face southwest and run straight until you reach the cliff wall in the distance. Once you reach the cliff face, turn left and use the machinery in front of you to climb up to the rock ledge above.

After reaching the ledge, face north. The Deathclaw Egg will be directly in front of you.
